attractions.descriptionEn: A sandbar of white coral sand off the northern coast—perfect for swimming and photo stops with Hibok-Hibok in the background.
attractions.descriptionFil: Isang sandbar ng puting coral sand sa hilagang baybayin—ideal para sa paglangoy at litrato na may tanaw ang Hibok-Hibok.
attractions.descriptionBis: Sandbar nga puti nga coral sand sa amihanang baybayon—maayo sa paglangoy ug litrato uban ang Hibok-Hibok.

attractions.descriptionEn: A small island sanctuary with white sand, snorkeling, and a short forest walk.
attractions.descriptionFil: Maliit na isla na may puting buhangin, snorkeling, at maikling lakad sa gubat.
attractions.descriptionBis: Gamay nga isla nga puti ang balas, snorkeling, ug mubo nga lakaw sa lasang.

attractions.descriptionEn: A submerged cemetery marked by a large cross offshore—iconic after the 1871 eruption.
attractions.descriptionFil: Lumulutang na sementeryo na may malaking krus sa dagat—kilala pagkatapos ng pagsabog noong 1871.
attractions.descriptionBis: Lubog nga sementeryo nga may dakong krus sa dagat—nailhan human sa 1871 nga pagbuto.

attractions.descriptionEn: Guiob Church ruins—stone walls left from volcanic destruction, a quiet heritage stop.
attractions.descriptionFil: Guho ng Guiob Church—mga batong pader na natira mula sa pagsabog, tahimik na heritage stop.
attractions.descriptionBis: Guba sa Guiob Church—mga bato nga nahabilin human sa pagbuto, hilom nga heritage stop.

attractions.descriptionEn: A towering waterfall cascading into a cool pool—one of Camiguin’s signature nature spots.
attractions.descriptionFil: Mataas na talon na bumabagsak sa malamig na pool—isa sa signature nature spots ng Camiguin.
attractions.descriptionBis: Taas nga busay nga nahulog sa bugnaw nga pool—usa sa signature nature spots sa Camiguin.

attractions.descriptionEn: A scenic inland waterfall popular for short treks and cooling off.
attractions.descriptionFil: Scenic na inland waterfall para sa maikling trek at pagpapalamig.
attractions.descriptionBis: Scenic nga inland waterfall para sa mubo nga trek ug pagpabugnaw.

attractions.descriptionEn: A multi-tier waterfall experience with a rewarding trek atmosphere.
attractions.descriptionFil: Multi-tier na waterfall na may rewarding trek.
attractions.descriptionBis: Multi-tier nga waterfall nga rewarding ang trek.

attractions.descriptionEn: Bura Natural Soda Water Pool—naturally carbonated spring water in a landscaped pool setting.
attractions.descriptionFil: Bura Natural Soda Water Pool—natural na carbonated spring water sa landscaped pool.
attractions.descriptionBis: Bura Natural Soda Water Pool—natural nga carbonated spring water sa landscaped pool.

attractions.descriptionEn: Volcanic hot spring pools set in a lush hillside resort atmosphere.
attractions.descriptionFil: Volcanic hot spring pools sa lush na hillside resort.
attractions.descriptionBis: Volcanic hot spring pools sa lush nga hillside resort.

attractions.descriptionEn: Crystal-clear cold spring pools ideal for swimming and weekend family visits.
attractions.descriptionFil: Malinaw na cold spring pools para sa paglangoy at family weekend.
attractions.descriptionBis: Klaro nga cold spring pools para sa paglangoy ug family weekend.

attractions.descriptionEn: PHIVOLCS monitoring viewpoint for Hibok-Hibok with educational context on volcanic activity.
attractions.descriptionFil: Viewpoint ng PHIVOLCS para sa Hibok-Hibok na may educational context tungkol sa aktibidad ng bulkan.
attractions.descriptionBis: Viewpoint sa PHIVOLCS para sa Hibok-Hibok nga may educational context bahin sa aktibidad sa bulkan.

attractions.descriptionEn: Camiguin’s active volcano and hiking icon—permits and guides are recommended.
attractions.descriptionFil: Aktibong bulkan at hiking icon ng Camiguin—inirerekomenda ang permit at guide.
attractions.descriptionBis: Aktibong bulkan ug hiking icon sa Camiguin—girekomendar ang permit ug guide.

attractions.descriptionEn: A marine conservation site showcasing giant clams in clear coastal waters.
attractions.descriptionFil: Marine conservation site na may giant clams sa malinaw na baybayin.
attractions.descriptionBis: Marine conservation site nga may giant clams sa klaro nga baybayon.

attractions.descriptionEn: Community eco-tourism village experience highlighting local culture and nature.
attractions.descriptionFil: Community eco-tourism village na nagha-highlight ng lokal na kultura at kalikasan.
attractions.descriptionBis: Community eco-tourism village nga nag-highlight sa lokal nga kultura ug kinaiyahan.

attractions.descriptionEn: Historic coastal watchtower ruins reflecting Camiguin’s maritime heritage.
attractions.descriptionFil: Historikong guho ng coastal watchtower na sumasalamin sa maritime heritage ng Camiguin.
attractions.descriptionBis: Historikong guba sa coastal watchtower nga nagpakita sa maritime heritage sa Camiguin.

attractions.descriptionEn: A long stairway pilgrimage route toward Old Volcano stations with island panoramas.
attractions.descriptionFil: Mahabang stairway pilgrimage route papunta sa Old Volcano stations na may panorama ng isla.
attractions.descriptionBis: Taas nga stairway pilgrimage route padulong sa Old Volcano stations nga may panorama sa isla.

attractions.descriptionEn: Natural spring pools known locally for cool freshwater swimming.
attractions.descriptionFil: Natural spring pools na kilala sa malamig na freshwater swimming.
attractions.descriptionBis: Natural spring pools nga nailhan sa bugnaw nga freshwater swimming.

attractions.descriptionEn: Main ferry gateway connecting Camiguin with Mindanao mainland routes.
attractions.descriptionFil: Pangunahing ferry gateway na nag-uugnay sa Camiguin at Mindanao mainland.
attractions.descriptionBis: Panguna nga ferry gateway nga nagkonektar sa Camiguin ug Mindanao mainland.

attractions.descriptionEn: Mambajao-area port used for local boat and passenger connections.
attractions.descriptionFil: Pantalan sa may Mambajao para sa lokal na bangka at pasahero.
attractions.descriptionBis: Pantalan duol sa Mambajao para sa lokal nga bangka ug pasahero.

attractions.descriptionEn: Island airport serving limited commercial flights to and from Camiguin.
attractions.descriptionFil: Paliparan ng isla na may limited commercial flights papunta at mula Camiguin.
attractions.descriptionBis: Tugpahanan sa isla nga may limited commercial flights padulong ug gikan Camiguin.
